verdict.rationale: Unleash documents 15 official client and server SDKs plus community SDKs, with quickstart guides showing SDK integration into codebases, API tokens/keys scoped for SDK use, and a comprehensive Admin API for programmatic access — all first-party, official channels for building against the platform. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK quality or breadth across languages beyond vendor docs, and no per-language SDK documentation detail in the pack.
